name: Cary C. Chen
office: Rowland Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Cary C. Chen is the president of the Rowland Unified School District Board of Education. He was first elected in 2009. His professional background includes work as a geophysicist at Western Geophysical and UNOCAL, and as a corporate executive in charge of international operations. In a campaign questionnaire, he says he has volunteered for decades in an after-school program. He also says he uses data-driven decision-making to improve academic achievement. In 2026, the board opened a new $36 million fine arts and aquatics center at Nogales High School, funded by the 2012 Measure R bond.
